cross_family_boundary: Acid Wolfe versus modified Wolfe has positive material differences: NTA and cobalt nitrate in modified recipes, versus cobalt chloride, nickel double sulfate and tungstate in acid recipes, with different input amounts and acid/base treatment. This is a formulation distinction, not one derived from absent hydration.
